newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel stronger -barges tight, cargoes quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel stronger -barges tight, cargoes quiet.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was slightly higher on futures although traders said cargo premiums were easier due to slack demand.
Traders said most players appeared to have covered their cargo requirements for September earlier in the month.
"When people saw what looked like the start of Gulf War II erupting they covered their requirements as quick as possible," one trader said. "So now it's pretty boring.
On the cif cargo market, premiums were assessed at Oct IPE +$34/+$35. Barge premiums were put at Oct IPE +$27/+$30 fob ARA amid tight supply. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714
